issue.title: Download sync fails with large number of tracks
issue.body:
I have an album which I dump my favorites in from various platforms so I can have them offline.
There are currently 1038 files in there, yet only 990 tracks sync. There are 1209 synced as well, so total 2199.

Is there debug info I can give you from the likes of idevicesyslog?

Love the app thank you 🤗

comment.body:
Thank you @Komodo5197 , closing this as user error. Disabling quick sync fixed this. Presumably this was added after I set this up.

Syncing a library is much preferable as I can then have things in their published albums. Aaah, and there is the option hiding in plain sight 😅

comment.body:
The playlist is an album and the album shows all the tracks. Normally I'm breeding via the 'Tracks' menu to access them.
The album is favorited, slows 1030 tracks in online mode and 990 in offline mode.

I'd love to be able to sync a while library, but putting all the tracks in one album and favoriting the album was the way I figured to do it 😅.

comment.body:
Thank you @Victor2820 for the detailed analysis.
I implemented these changes and found that there was the same level flakiness with stalls instead of quit, adding additional INFO logging helped to understand what is happening.
I am trying with the addition of  an option `--ignore-index-state` to just go regardless of state, which feel like it may be enough in the case where I sync photos daily. Will test tomorrow and see what happens!

(By _I_ I mean my AI coding bots 🤣)
